nodes.description: Private constant bytes32 guard value keccak256("guard.bytes32") used as the sentinel for the guard state variable.
Address of the library contract invoked via delegatecall from batchLogs; set once in the constructor.
bytes32 guard state variable initialized to GUARD_VALUE and checked in batchLogs.
Public mapping from beneficiary address to an array of UnlockSchedule structs.
Constructor that stores gatedLogBatcherLib and initializes guard to GUARD_VALUE.
Public function that checks guard, performs a delegatecall into gatedLogBatcherLib with multiSend(bytes), and emits BatchLogs.
Constructor parameter holding the address of the batcher library, assigned to the gatedLogBatcherLib state variable.
Bytes parameter of batchLogs, ABI-encoded into the delegatecall calldata and hashed for the BatchLogs event.
Boolean return flag of the delegatecall in batchLogs.
Bytes return data of the delegatecall in batchLogs.
delegatecall into gatedLogBatcherLib using multiSend(bytes) selector, executing external code in the context of this contract.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the _gatedLogBatcherLib argument into the gatedLogBatcherLib state variable.
Constructor assigns GUARD_VALUE to the guard state variable.
Constructor consumes its address parameter and forwards it to the gatedLogBatcherLib state variable.
batchLogs reads guard inside require(guard != GUARD_VALUE), which gates entry to the privileged execution path but is permanently unsatisfiable given the constructor initialization.
The guard check compares the guard state variable against the constant GUARD_VALUE, defining the (broken) access condition of batchLogs.
The delegatecall target is taken straight from the gatedLogBatcherLib state variable, so whoever controls that address controls arbitrary code executed in this contract's storage context.
The logs parameter is ABI-encoded into the calldata of the delegatecall.
batchLogs consumes its logs byte parameter for both hashing and the delegatecall payload.
The delegatecall result assigns the success boolean local variable.
The delegatecall result assigns the returned bytes local variable data.
batchLogs unconditionally reaches the delegatecall after the guard require statement.
The delegatecall transfers execution to external code (gatedLogBatcherLib) which runs with this contract's state and can re-enter or mutate storage before batchLogs continues.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter only exists to initialize the gatedLogBatcherLib state variable inside the constructor and has no independent role.
The logs byte parameter is forwarded directly into the delegatecall calldata and is fully represented by that unsafe operation.
success is solely the boolean return flag of the delegatecall and carries no separate semantic meaning.
data is solely the returned bytes of the delegatecall and is never used elsewhere in the function.
